hints.title: Traverse Right to Left
hints.text: A building has an ocean view if and only if it is strictly taller than the maximum height of buildings to its right.

hints.title: Maintain Running Suffix Maximum
hints.text: Scan from index n - 1 down to 0, maintaining the max building height seen so far.

hints.title: Reverse Result Order
hints.text: Collect valid indices in reverse chronological order and reverse before returning.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every building against all buildings to its right takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Right-to-left suffix sweep evaluates visibility in linear O(n) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses backward sweep or monotonic stack to preserve linear time.
